name: describir_esquema
description: Describe the legacy tables and columns available to the current user, with the data dictionary (meaning of each cryptic name and value formats). Call it before writing SQL.

tablas.description: Tables to describe. Omit to list every table available to the user.

name: buscar_regla_negocio
description: Search the company's business rules (coverage, risk, reorder policy, purchase proposals and approvals, surplus between distribution centers, ABC class...). Returns the exact definition to compute. Use it whenever a question mentions a business term.

consulta.description: Words to search for (Spanish or English), or a rule id such as R-COB.

name: muestrear_valores
description: Return the most frequent distinct values of one column, to check how data is stored (country codes, city names, category spelling, status codes) before filtering.

name: ejecutar_sql
description: Validate and run one SELECT over the legacy tables in a read-only transaction, with time and row limits. Returns columns, rows (up to max_filas) and the total row count.

sql.description: One PostgreSQL SELECT over the legacy tables.

max_filas.description: Maximum rows to return; the total is always reported.

name: proponer_orden_compra
description: Register a purchase order PROPOSAL for human approval. It never creates, approves or executes an order: a person with the authorization level of the amount must approve it. Only for users with the purchasing role. Every field is required: if the user did not give the delivery CEDIS or the required date, ask for them (pregunta_aclaracion) instead of choosing one. cedis is legado.almmst.alm_id (look it up with ejecutar_sql when the user names a city or a CEDIS by name).

motivo.description: Reason: reorden automático, compra urgente o proyecto especial, with a short note.

fecha_requerida.description: Required date, AAAA-MM-DD, as the user gave it.

solicitante.description: Requester: the subject (sub) of the verified token, set by the agent Lambda, never by the model. The gateway's policy allows the call only when it is the caller's own sub.
